tiers.confirmed: BY-FDR q <= 0.05 across the whole tested family (the citable tier)
tiers.detected: z >= 3 against the site's own 24 pseudo-site null (single-site test)
tiers.not detected: z < 2; an 84th-percentile upper limit is reported

fdr.statement: Among sites marked detected, the expected share of false entries is <= 5% under arbitrary dependence.

method.stack: wind-rotated, footprint-drizzled, plane background, monsoon (Jun-Sep) excluded, noise-weighted, albedo/AOT bias removed (ABD)
method.calibration: x gamma (ERA5 100 m / 10 m wind) / OBC slope 0.989
method.uncertainty: Monte Carlo 4000: overpass bootstrap + null structure + gamma
